flows.title: Add a task to an opportunity
steps: Open the Opportunity (your project) and scroll to the Related > Tasks section.
Click the + icon to create a new task.
Assign an owner and a due date, and add the details.
To break the work down, open the task's detail view and add subtasks; each can be checked off as it is completed.
Track progress by updating the task's status as the work proceeds. To see every task across projects, use the Task List View and group or filter it by related record, due date, owner or status.

flows.title: Focus the Feed on the activity that matters
steps: Open the Feed, the first thing you see when you log in to Copper.
Choose the Following tab to see updates only on records you follow, or the All tab to see every activity across the company.
Use the filters to focus on activity types, such as emails, calls or meetings, or on one teammate's activity.
Save a filter you use often so you can pick it again quickly, and share it with your team if they need the same view.
Open an item in the Preview Drawer to review the record, reply to an email, or log an interaction without leaving the Feed.
